name: python-rope
title: Cached-Length Chunks
blurb: A binary rope of short leaf chunks with cached lengths: insert, delete, slice, and concat walk the spine instead of copying the text, and to_string is the join of the leaves in order.
default_description: A balanced rope of cached-length chunks that edits by walking, joins without copying, and proves every slice against a plain string.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff
